title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 13, MAT-MIC - EB.10
text: for its commodious harbours; for a city well built, with artifacts of every kind, especially weaver of fine lines, all owing to the Picomansians, the first colonists. Now Mala / remarkable for St Fash hipperole. See MALTA.
